fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after arrival and at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a la llegada y al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote:
an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive

- at least 2 blank pages

entry.en: You can visit without a visa for up to 45 days for tourism or business.
entry.es: Se puede visitar sin visado hasta 45 días por turismo o negocios.
entry.quote: You can visit Vietnam without a visa for up to 45 days for tourism or business.

entry.en: An e-visa allows a 90-day stay and multiple entries.
entry.es: Un e-visado permite una estancia de 90 días y múltiples entradas.
entry.quote: apply for an e-visa that allows a 90-day stay and multiple entries

entry.en: The digital arrival card is not currently mandatory at Tan Son Nhat airport, but this may change or extend to other airports at short notice.
entry.es: La tarjeta digital de llegada no es obligatoria por ahora en el aeropuerto de Tan Son Nhat, pero esto puede cambiar o extenderse a otros aeropuertos con poco aviso.
entry.quote: The digital arrival card system is not currently a mandatory requirement for entry into Vietnam via Tan Son Nhat airport, but this may change, or be rolled out to other airports in Vietnam with limited notice.

entry.en: From 1 July, travellers to or through Vietnam may be required to complete a health declaration that may include proof of vaccinations.
entry.es: Desde el 1 de julio, quienes viajen a Vietnam o transiten por él podrían tener que completar una declaración de salud que puede incluir prueba de vacunación.
entry.quote: from 1 July, if you travel to or transit through Vietnam you may be required to complete a health declaration, which may include providing proof of vaccinations.

entry.en: Cash over 15 million dong or 5,000 US dollars must be declared when taken into or out of Vietnam.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo superior a 15 millones de dongs o 5.000 dólares estadounidenses al entrar o salir de Vietnam.
entry.quote:
If you’re taking cash into or out of Vietnam, you must declare amounts over:

- 15 million Vietnamese dong

- 5,000 US dollars (or the same value in other currencies)

safety.en: Bag-snatching by thieves on motorcycles is common, so hold bags in front of you or on the side away from traffic.
safety.es: Los robos de bolsos por ladrones en moto son frecuentes, así que lleve el bolso delante o en el lado contrario al tráfico.
safety.quote: Bag-snatching by thieves on motorcycles is common, hold bags in front of you or on the opposite side of the traffic to make them difficult to steal.

safety.en: British nationals have reported rape and sexual assaults in main tourist areas, often by or linked to unlicenced taxi drivers.
safety.es: Ciudadanos británicos han denunciado violaciones y agresiones sexuales en las principales zonas turísticas, a menudo cometidas por taxistas sin licencia o vinculados a ellos.
safety.quote: British nationals have reported rape and sexual assaults in the main tourist areas and places where foreigners live, often committed by or linked to unlicenced taxi drivers.

safety.en: Use pre-arranged transport or official taxi hailing apps such as Grab or XanhSM, which supply licenced cabs.
safety.es: Use transporte reservado o apps oficiales de taxi como Grab o XanhSM, que ofrecen taxis con licencia.
safety.quote: use pre-arranged transport or official taxi hailing apps, such as Grab or XanhSM, which supply licenced cabs.

safety.en: There have been deaths and serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol.
safety.es: Ha habido muertes y casos graves de enfermedad causados por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Vietnam.

safety.en: Some protests have turned violent or been violently suppressed, and travellers should avoid all protests.
safety.es: Algunas protestas se han vuelto violentas o han sido reprimidas con violencia, y se aconseja evitar todas las protestas.
safety.quote: Some protests in recent years have turned violent or been violently suppressed by the authorities. Avoid all protests.

safety.en: Motorbike accidents are common and have killed and injured British nationals.
safety.es: Los accidentes de moto son frecuentes y han causado muertos y heridos entre ciudadanos británicos.
safety.quote: Travelling by motorbike in Vietnam is much riskier than in the UK. Motorbike accidents are common and have killed and injured British nationals.

health.en: Tap water is not safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber.
health.quote: Tap water is not safe to drink.

health.en: Health risks include mosquito-borne diseases like Zika virus, dengue, malaria and Japanese encephalitis.
health.es: Entre los riesgos para la salud figuran enfermedades transmitidas por mosquitos como zika, dengue, malaria y encefalitis japonesa.
health.quote: mosquito-borne diseases like Zika virus, dengue, malaria and Japanese encephalitis

health.en: Some medicines can be hard to find in Vietnam and many are fake.
health.es: Algunos medicamentos son difíciles de encontrar en Vietnam y muchos son falsos.
health.quote: Some medicines can be hard to find in Vietnam and many are fake.

health.en: It is illegal to have more than 7 days of doctor-prescribed addictive or psychotropic medicine.
health.es: Es ilegal llevar más de 7 días de medicamento adictivo o psicotrópico recetado por un médico.
health.quote: It is illegal to have more than 7 days of prescribed medicine by a doctor (addictive and psychotropic medicine).

health.en: Vietnamese hospitals are generally not up to Western standards and are often short of medicines and supplies.
health.es: Los hospitales vietnamitas en general no alcanzan los estándares occidentales y a menudo carecen de medicamentos y suministros.
health.quote: Vietnamese hospitals are generally not up to Western standards. Hospitals are often short of medicines and other supplies

health.en: Comprehensive travel insurance is described as very important when travelling to Vietnam.
health.es: Se describe como muy importante contratar un seguro de viaje completo al viajar a Vietnam.
health.quote: When travelling to Vietnam, it is very important to take out comprehensive travel insurance.

help.en: The emergency numbers are ambulance 115, fire 114, police 113 and national search and rescue 112.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 115, bomberos 114, policía 113 y búsqueda y rescate nacional 112.
help.quote:
Ambulance: 115

Fire: 114

Police: 113

National search and rescue: 112

help.en: Emergency numbers in Vietnam are operated in Vietnamese only.
help.es: Los números de emergencia de Vietnam funcionan solo en vietnamita.
help.quote: Emergency numbers in Vietnam are operated in Vietnamese only.

help.en: Travellers should take a translator when reporting a crime to the police and always get a police report.
help.es: Se aconseja llevar un traductor al denunciar un delito ante la policía y obtener siempre un informe policial.
help.quote: Take a translator with you when you report a crime to the local police. Always get a police report when you report a crime.

help.en: The British Embassy does not pay medical bills and cannot provide medical assistance.
help.es: La Embajada británica no paga facturas médicas y no puede prestar asistencia médica.
help.quote: The British Embassy do not pay medical bills and cannot provide medical assistance.

getting_in.en: The main international airports are Hanoi (HAN) and Ho Chi Minh City (SGN).
getting_in.es: Los principales aeropuertos internacionales son Hanoi (HAN) y Ciudad Ho Chi Minh (SGN).
getting_in.quote: Vietnam's main international airports are located at Hanoi (HAN IATA) and Ho Chi Minh City (SGN IATA).

getting_in.en: Da Nang is closer to the historical sites of Central Vietnam and can be a convenient entry point.
getting_in.es: Da Nang está más cerca de los sitios históricos del centro de Vietnam y puede ser un punto de entrada práctico.
getting_in.quote: As Da Nang is closer to the historical sites of Central Vietnam than the two main airports, it can make a convenient entry point for those who wish to visit those sites.

getting_in.en: A nightly sleeper train runs between Nanning in China and Hanoi, taking 12 hours including time at the border.
getting_in.es: Un tren nocturno con literas une Nanning (China) y Hanói en 12 horas, incluido el tiempo en la frontera.
getting_in.quote: There is a nightly sleeper train between Nanning in China and Hanoi, taking 12 hours, including a tedious 2+2 hours at the border

getting_in.en: There are no railway links between Vietnam and Laos or Cambodia.
getting_in.es: No hay conexiones ferroviarias entre Vietnam y Laos o Camboya.
getting_in.quote: There are no railway links between Vietnam and Laos or Cambodia.

getting_in.en: The main crossing with Cambodia is Bavet–Moc Bai, with buses between Phnom Penh and Ho Chi Minh City costing US$22–25 and taking around 6–7 hours.
getting_in.es: El principal paso con Camboya es Bavet–Moc Bai, con autobuses entre Phnom Penh y Ciudad Ho Chi Minh que cuestan 22–25 USD y tardan unas 6–7 horas.
getting_in.quote: The main crossing with Cambodia is the already above mentioned Bavet–Moc Bai crossing on the Phnom Penh–Ho Chi Minh City road. Buses between the two cities cost US$22–25 and take around 6–7 hr.

getting_in.en: Vietnam e-Visas are not accepted at the Oyadav–Lệ Thanh crossing between Banlung and Pleiku.
getting_in.es: Los e-visados de Vietnam no se aceptan en el paso Oyadav–Lệ Thanh entre Banlung y Pleiku.
getting_in.quote: Vietnam e-Visas are not accepted for entering Vietnam at this border crossing.

getting_around.en: The main train line is the 1,723 km trunk between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, which takes more than 30 hours.
getting_around.es: La línea principal de tren es el tronco de 1.723 km entre Hanói y Ciudad Ho Chi Minh, que tarda más de 30 horas.
getting_around.quote: There is one major train line in Vietnam, the 1,723 km (1,071 mi) trunk between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), on which the Reunification Express runs. HCMC to Hanoi is more than 30 hours

getting_around.en: Train tickets can be booked online on the official Vietnamese Railways website, which has an English version and accepts international bank cards.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de tren se pueden reservar en línea en la web oficial de Ferrocarriles de Vietnam, que tiene versión en inglés y acepta tarjetas bancarias internacionales.
getting_around.quote: Booking online is possible through the official Vietnamese Railways website, which has an English version and accepts payments by international bank cards.

getting_around.en: Many websites imitate the official Vietnam Railways site and can charge about twice the price.
getting_around.es: Muchos sitios web imitan la web oficial de Ferrocarriles de Vietnam y pueden cobrar aproximadamente el doble.
getting_around.quote: Beware of the many websites that may look like they are the official Vietnam Railways website and that often appear at the top of Google search results. These websites usually list their fares in US dollars rather than VND, and their prices can easily be twice as high

getting_around.en: Long-distance buses connect most cities, and most depart early in the morning or run overnight.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses de larga distancia conectan la mayoría de las ciudades, y casi todos salen temprano por la mañana o circulan de noche.
getting_around.quote: Long-distance buses connect most cities in Vietnam. Most depart early in the morning to accommodate traffic and late afternoon rains, or run overnight.

getting_around.en: Foreigners are likely to be overcharged on local buses where the fare is paid to a conductor.
getting_around.es: Es probable que a los extranjeros les cobren de más en los autobuses locales donde se paga a un cobrador.
getting_around.quote: As a foreigner, you are likely to get overcharged on local buses, where you pay a conductor during the journey.

getting_around.en: Open tour buses let you break the journey anywhere and continue later on the same company's bus.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses open tour permiten interrumpir el viaje en cualquier punto y continuar más tarde con un autobús de la misma empresa.
getting_around.quote: You can break the journey at any point and continue on a bus of the same company any time later, or simply buy tickets just for the stage you're willing to cover next.

money.en: The national currency is the dong (VND).
money.es: La moneda nacional es el dong (VND).
money.quote: The national currency is the dong (đồng), sometimes denoted by the symbol "₫" (ISO code: VND).

money.en: ATMs are common in most cities and every tourist destination.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos son habituales en la mayoría de las ciudades y en todos los destinos turísticos.
money.quote: ATMs are common and can be found in most cities and every tourist destination.

money.en: Many ATMs charge a fee per withdrawal, but a few are free.
money.es: Muchos cajeros cobran una comisión por retirada, pero algunos son gratuitos.
money.quote: Many ATMs charge a fee per withdrawal, but a few are free.

money.en: Cards are accepted more and more, especially where there are many tourists, and card purchases must be charged in dong by law.
money.es: Las tarjetas se aceptan cada vez más, sobre todo donde hay muchos turistas, y por ley los pagos con tarjeta deben cobrarse en dongs.
money.quote: Credit/debit cards are now accepted more and more around the country, especially where there is a lot of tourists present. Credit/debit card purchases are required by law to be charged in dong.

money.en: To get some smaller notes, withdraw an amount like 4.9 million instead of 5 million dong.
money.es: Para obtener algunos billetes pequeños, retire una cantidad como 4,9 millones en lugar de 5 millones de dongs.
money.quote: To ensure you get at least some smaller note sizes, withdraw for example 4.9 million instead of 5 million.

money.en: Money should only be changed at official exchange counters with a clear sign, as changing it elsewhere is illegal.
money.es: Solo se debe cambiar dinero en casas de cambio oficiales con letrero visible, ya que hacerlo en otro sitio es ilegal.
money.quote: Only change money at official money exchange counters with a clear sign showing this status. Changing money elsewhere is illegal and you risk losing your money.

etiquette.en: Elders are treated with great deference and respect.
etiquette.es: A las personas mayores se las trata con gran deferencia y respeto.
etiquette.quote: In traditional Vietnamese culture, elders are treated with great deference and respect.

etiquette.en: Public displays of affection are generally considered disrespectful, even among married couples.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto se consideran en general una falta de respeto, incluso entre parejas casadas.
etiquette.quote: All couples should be aware that public displays of affection are generally considered disrespectful in Vietnam, even among married couples, and it's advisable to show restraint in public.

etiquette.en: To be safe regarding respect or formality, cover your shoulders and knees.
etiquette.es: Para ir sobre seguro en cuanto a respeto o formalidad, conviene cubrirse los hombros y las rodillas.
etiquette.quote: Generally, if you want to be on the safe side regarding respect or especially formality, you should try to cover your shoulders and knees.

etiquette.en: Saving face is very important, so avoid pointing out other people's mistakes.
etiquette.es: Salvar las apariencias es muy importante, así que conviene evitar señalar los errores ajenos.
etiquette.quote: Saving face is very important in Vietnamese culture. You should generally avoid pointing out the mistakes of others no matter how minor they might be in order to avoid causing major embarrassment.

etiquette.en: You are expected to remove your shoes before entering people's homes.
etiquette.es: Se espera que uno se quite los zapatos antes de entrar en las casas.
etiquette.quote: As in many other Asian countries, you are expected to remove your shoes before entering people's homes.

etiquette.en: Relations with China are a sensitive issue best not discussed with locals.
etiquette.es: Las relaciones con China son un tema delicado que es mejor no tratar con la gente local.
etiquette.quote: Relations with China are a sensitive issue best not discussed with locals.

connectivity.en: Physical SIM cards can be bought at the airport on arrival at a markup, and prices are lower after leaving the airport.
connectivity.es: Se pueden comprar tarjetas SIM físicas en el aeropuerto a la llegada con sobreprecio, y los precios son más bajos fuera del aeropuerto.
connectivity.quote: Physical SIM cards from all the main providers can be purchased on arrival at the airport, though they are sold at a markup. Try holding off until leaving the airport to buy a SIM card, where prices will be lower.

connectivity.en: eSIMs can be bought online before arrival and activated instantly upon landing.
connectivity.es: Las eSIM se pueden comprar en línea antes de llegar y activarse al aterrizar.
connectivity.quote: eSIMs are also available, which can be purchased online before arrival and activated instantly upon landing

connectivity.en: MobiFone offers tourists a free one-day eSIM plan with 8GB of data.
connectivity.es: MobiFone ofrece a los turistas un plan eSIM gratuito de un día con 8 GB de datos.
connectivity.quote: MobiFone offers a free one-day eSIM plan for tourists with 8GB of data and unlimited access to Facebook, YouTube and TikTok included.

connectivity.en: Coverage is generally strong in cities and along major routes, but may be slower in rural or mountainous areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura es en general buena en ciudades y rutas principales, pero puede ser más lenta en zonas rurales o montañosas.
connectivity.quote: Coverage is generally strong in cities and along major travel routes, with 4G and increasing 5G availability; speeds may be slower in rural or mountainous areas.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is widespread and most hotels, restaurants and bars in main tourist centres have it free.
connectivity.es: El wifi está muy extendido y la mayoría de hoteles, restaurantes y bares de los principales centros turísticos lo ofrecen gratis.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi is widespread in Vietnam and most hotels, restaurants and bars in the main tourist centres have free Wi-Fi.

connectivity.en: Local authorities can block access to websites and social media, and users should not expect internet privacy.
connectivity.es: Las autoridades locales pueden bloquear sitios web y redes sociales, y no se debe esperar privacidad en internet.
connectivity.quote:
Within the Vietnamese territory, local authorities can block access to:

- websites 

- social Media

You should not expect internet privacy.
